rules.rationale: A countdown for the same offer should only go down. If it goes back up without the offer changing, the deadline is probably not real.

emit.title: Countdown may not be genuine
emit.summary: The "{item.text}" timer went back up {item.resetCount} time(s) for the same offer.
emit.consumerImpact: A deadline that keeps restarting can rush you into a decision you would otherwise take time over.
emit.recommendedAction: Ignore the timer. Compare the price elsewhere or check back later.

evidence.description: Timer value increased across {item.observations} observations with no change of offer.

limitations: Some offers legitimately restart daily. Confirm by reloading after the timer ends.

rules.rationale: A paid membership, protection plan, service, tip or donation in the basket should be there because the shopper chose it.

emit.title: Possible item added without your choice
emit.summary: "{item.title}" ({item.amount|inr}) is in your basket, and FairCart did not see you add it.
emit.consumerImpact: You may pay {item.amount|inr} for something you did not choose.
emit.recommendedAction: Check the basket and remove "{item.title}" if you did not mean to add it.

evidence.description: Paid line item present (origin: {item.origin}); no tap recorded on it.

limitations: FairCart only knows about taps it observed. If you added this before FairCart was active, dismiss the finding.

rules.rationale: A paid add-on such as a warranty, protection plan or pass should start unticked. A ticked one that the shopper did not tap will be charged.

emit.title: Paid add-on already ticked
emit.summary: "{item.label}" ({item.paidAmount|inr}) is ticked, and FairCart did not see you tick it.
emit.consumerImpact: You may be charged {item.paidAmount|inr} for an add-on you did not ask for.
emit.recommendedAction: Untick it if you don't want it. FairCart never changes it for you.

evidence.description: Paid add-on control is checked with no recorded tap.

limitations: If you ticked it before FairCart was turned on for this site, dismiss this.

rules.rationale: Decline options should be neutral. Wording that frames saying no as foolish or careless is confirm shaming.

emit.title: Decline option uses guilt-tripping wording
emit.summary: The option to say no reads "{item.label}".
emit.consumerImpact: Loaded wording can push you into an add-on or subscription you do not need.
emit.recommendedAction: Decide on the offer itself. Choosing this option only declines the offer.

evidence.description: Decline control label matches shaming phrasing.

rules.rationale: Requiring an app install or a paid membership to continue a purchase is an unrelated forced action. Login on its own is not flagged because it can be needed for delivery.

emit.title: Possible unnecessary requirement to continue
emit.summary: This screen asks for "{item.text}" before you can continue.
emit.consumerImpact: You may be pushed into an install or membership that is not needed for this purchase.
emit.recommendedAction: Look for a way to continue without it, such as the website or a guest option.
limitations: Some gates are optional or can be skipped further down the screen.

rules.rationale: When a member is managing a paid membership, there should be a visible way to cancel it.

emit.title: No visible way to cancel this membership
emit.summary: You are enrolled in "{snapshot.membership.name}", but FairCart found no cancel option on this screen.
emit.consumerImpact: A membership that is hard to cancel can keep charging you.
emit.recommendedAction: Look for cancellation under account settings or help, and note how many steps it takes.

evidence.description: Membership management screen without a cancel control.

limitations: The cancel route may be on another screen. Run the guided cancellation test to confirm.

rules.rationale: If accepting is many times more prominent than declining, the design steers the choice.

emit.title: Decline option is much harder to see
emit.summary: "{item.label}" is about {item.prominenceRatio}x more prominent than the option to decline.
emit.consumerImpact: A faint decline option makes accepting the paid choice the easy path.
emit.recommendedAction: Look for the smaller decline option before you continue.

evidence.description: Size × contrast × weight ratio of accept to decline.

limitations: Prominence is estimated from size, contrast and weight. Placement is not yet considered.

rules.rationale: The product page should show the same price as the listing card the shopper tapped, unless the shopper changed the variant.

emit.title: Price is higher than the listing you tapped
emit.summary: The listing showed {derived.entryPrice|inr}, but this page shows {derived.currentPrice|inr} ({derived.priceDeltaPct|pct} more).
emit.consumerImpact: You may pay more than the price that drew you in.
emit.recommendedAction: Check that the size, pack and seller match the listing before you add to cart.

evidence.description: Listing card price {derived.entryPrice|inr}; product page price {derived.currentPrice|inr}.

limitations: Prices can legitimately change between page loads. Reload once to confirm.

rules.rationale: A mandatory fee should be visible before checkout. A claim is only made if FairCart saw the earlier stages and the fee was not disclosed there.

emit.title: Possible late checkout fee
emit.summary: "{item.label}" ({item.amount|inr}) first appeared at checkout and was not shown on the product page or in the cart.
emit.consumerImpact: The amount you pay is higher than the price you saw earlier.
emit.recommendedAction: Review the itemised bill before paying, and compare the full total with other stores.

evidence.description: Fee of kind {item.kind} first observed at stage {item.firstSeenStage}.

limitations: FairCart may have missed a disclosure in fine print it could not read.

rules.rationale: Paid placement is fine if it is labelled clearly. An ad slot with no label, or a label below basic legibility (under 9px or under 3:1 contrast), can look organic.

emit.title: Sponsored listing may look organic
emit.summary: "{item.title}" appears to be a paid placement with a missing or very faint label.
emit.consumerImpact: You may think this result ranks high on merit when it is an ad.
emit.recommendedAction: Compare it with the results below it before choosing.
limitations: The ad slot is identified from page markup, which can change.

rules.rationale: Once a prompt is dismissed, showing it again and again without a relevant change is nagging.

emit.title: Prompt keeps coming back
emit.summary: "{item.text}" was shown {item.timesShownAfterDismiss} more times after you dismissed it.
emit.consumerImpact: Repeated prompts wear you down into accepting something you already declined.
emit.recommendedAction: Dismiss it again. You can pause FairCart's hints if they add to the noise.

evidence.description: Prompt re-shown after a recorded dismissal.

rules.rationale: A checkbox or toggle should be understandable at a glance. Double negatives make consent unclear.

emit.title: Confusing wording on this option
emit.summary: "{item.label}" uses a double negative, so it is hard to tell what ticking it does.
emit.consumerImpact: You might agree to something, such as marketing messages, without meaning to.
emit.recommendedAction: Read the option twice and set it to what you actually want.

evidence.description: Control label contains a double negative.

limitations: Pattern-matched wording. Some phrasings may still be clear in context.

rules.rationale: Before signing up for a trial or paid membership, the recurring price, cadence and renewal date should be visible.

emit.title: Renewal terms not shown
emit.summary: "{snapshot.membership.name}" does not show its recurring price, billing cycle and renewal date here.
emit.consumerImpact: A trial or membership could renew at a price you were not told about.
emit.recommendedAction: Find the renewal price and date before you sign up, and set a reminder to cancel if needed.

evidence.description: Membership offer without visible renewal terms (price shown: {snapshot.membership.price|inr}).

limitations: Terms may sit behind a link FairCart did not open.

rules.rationale: Infection warnings or download prompts pointing outside the retailer are signs of scareware. These are rare on mainstream marketplaces.

emit.title: Suspicious warning or download
emit.summary: "{item.text}" may be a scare tactic or an off-site download.
emit.consumerImpact: Installing or paying here could expose your device or money.
emit.recommendedAction: Do not download or pay. Close the page and go back to the retailer directly.

evidence.description: Cue of kind {item.kind} on a shopping page.

limitations: Uncommon in mainstream marketplace checkout. Check the address bar for the real site.
